# --- GLFW ---
# Assuming you copied the standard GLFW folder (which comes with its own CMakeLists.txt)
# We turn off GLFW's tests and docs so they don't bloat your build
set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(glfw)

# --- GLM (Header-Only) ---
# GLM doesn't have .cpp files, so we make an "INTERFACE" library.
# This just means "whoever links to glm gets this include directory."
add_library(glm INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(glm INTERFACE glm)

# --- GLAD ---
# Assuming GLAD has its source in Glad/src/glad.c and headers in Glad/include
add_library(Glad STATIC Glad/src/glad.c)
target_include_directories(Glad PUBLIC Glad/include)

# --- ImGui ---
# Grab the core ImGui files and the specific OpenGL3/GLFW backends
file(GLOB IMGUI_SOURCES 
    "imgui/*.cpp"
    "imgui/backends/imgui_impl_glfw.cpp"
    "imgui/backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp"
)
add_library(ImGui STATIC ${IMGUI_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(ImGui PUBLIC imgui imgui/backends)
# ImGui needs GLFW and Glad to compile its backends
target_link_libraries(ImGui PRIVATE glfw Glad)

# --- STB (Header-Only) ---
add_library(stb INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(stb INTERFACE stb)
